payload.prompt:
Create a Europa Universalis V victory reward tree background DDS asset.
Subject: Create a wide, route-specific victory reward tree background for Prosperity Victory.
An Art Nouveau mood in leaf green and warm gold: a graceful cultivated tree rising from a hazy valley of orchards and terraces. It enters cropped at the bottom-center edge and climbs vertically toward the top-center, its slender stems branching generously and rhythmically to either side. Abundant, flourishing, alive.

Shared production rules:
A beautiful, high-quality 16:9 painting or photograph of a single tree standing close to the viewer, large enough to dominate the frame and partly block a hazy, distant landscape beyond it — near and far are the same place under the same light, not a collage. Let the tree feel bigger than the picture: at the edge named below, a branch or the trunk simply runs off the frame, as though only part of a larger tree was caught in view, so no roots or ground appear there. Let the trunk fork naturally into a handful of branches as it grows, each with some open, unembellished stretches of bark — a round button will be overlaid on the branches later, so avoid drawing circles, rings, or icons, but otherwise trust your own eye for where and how the branches should fall. Prioritize a gorgeous, atmospheric, painterly result over any rigid structure. No text or UI elements.
Reference image: retain only this route's identity motifs and restrained color language from the uploaded icon. The requested full-scene art medium and tree composition take precedence; do not turn this wide asset into an icon or copy the reference composition.
Distinctiveness: keep the result in the same visual family as the reference, but make it visibly different at a glance through changed shape language, object arrangement, cropping, or decorative accents.
Composition: follow the explicit edge-starting tree direction, trunk, branch topology, and clear waypoint zones in the subject. This is a full UI background, not a centered icon.
Target format: final DDS target is exactly 2048x1152 and must stay under 1,200,000 bytes.
Target-specific requirement: A beautiful, high-quality 16:9 painting or photograph of a single tree standing close to the viewer, large enough to dominate the frame and partly block a hazy, distant landscape beyond it — near and far are the same place under the same light, not a collage. Let the tree feel bigger than the picture: at the edge named below, a branch or the trunk simply runs off the frame, as though only part of a larger tree was caught in view, so no roots or ground appear there. Let the trunk fork naturally into a handful of branches as it grows, each with some open, unembellished stretches of bark — a round button will be overlaid on the branches later, so avoid drawing circles, rings, or icons, but otherwise trust your own eye for where and how the branches should fall. Prioritize a gorgeous, atmospheric, painterly result over any rigid structure. No text or UI elements.
Style rules:
Match the palette, brush feel, lighting, icon density, and framing discipline of the selected target's reference image. Keep the final subject and asset meaning driven by the selected batch entry, not the reference subject.
Extra composition rules:
Use the reference only as a style guide. Keep the result in the same visual family, but make it visibly distinct at a glance by changing the silhouette, crop, object arrangement, and ornament placement. Do not mirror the reference composition or reuse its exact outline.
Avoid:
text, letters, numbers, labels, UI buttons, circular nodes or rings, badges, medallions, icons on the tree, logos, watermark, flat 2D illustration, cutout foreground pasted over a backdrop, mismatched lighting between tree and background, visible roots or ground line at the cropped edge, whole tree fully contained in frame, second tree
